segments.name: Multifamily
segments.description: Owns, operates and develops multifamily residential assets in and around Washington, D.C., leasing units to tenants.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had 15 multifamily assets totaling 6,519 units (6,333 units at our share), which were 84.7% leased at our share.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Owns, operates and develops commercial properties in and around Washington, D.C., leasing office and retail space to tenants.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had 22 commercial assets totaling 7.3 million square feet (6.9 million square feet at our share), which were 77.5% leased at our share.

segments.name: Third-party real estate services
segments.description: Provides fee-based real estate services to third parties, including property management, leasing and development.
segments.evidence: In addition, our third-party real estate services business provides fee-based real estate services.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent under leases of multifamily and commercial properties, and third-party clients pay fees for real estate services.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue primarily from leases with multifamily and commercial tenants.
